messages:
raj: fyi hitting a pretty gnarly streaming issue in prod. clients (python async generator + ts frontend) see reconnects and when they resume the iterator sometimes jumps forward and we lose the final chunk. customer says partial output + later duplicate billing events. any ideas?

emma: sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal repro and server logs? also which SDK versions and model/route?

raj: sure. SDKs: py-sdk 0.11.4 + ts-sdk 1.3.2. route: /v1/streams/generate. repro steps: 1) start long stream (~20s) 2) kill client network briefly (~500ms) 3) client does reconnect+resume 4) python async iterator yields final frame missing. attached server logs show client reconnect id mismatch. logs:
```
# server log snippet
2026-02-20T15:12:01Z INFO stream start id=abc123 seq=0
2026-02-20T15:12:05Z WARN conn loss id=abc123
2026-02-20T15:12:06Z INFO resume attempt old_id=abc123 new_id=abc123-resume seq_expected=45
2026-02-20T15:12:06Z INFO resume accepted seq_next=46
2026-02-20T15:12:07Z INFO emit token seq=46 data="<partial>"
2026-02-20T15:12:07Z INFO heartbeat :hb\n\n
```

raj: the python client shows iterator closed right after the heartbeat then resume picks up and skips seq46 sometimes. in the ts client we get duplicate token events on reconnect.

emma: hm. that sounds like two issues: 1) heartbeat frame parsing can be conflated with SSE comment lines and causing the py async generator to interpret stream as finished, and 2) the resume handshake sometimes races with buffered event delivery causing duplicates.

arjun: I can try to repro locally. quick theory: our python async iterator's close path treats an empty comment line (":hb") followed by EOF as end-of-stream in some eventsource parsers. iirc aiohttp-sse-client behaves differently than eventsource polyfills in ts. can you confirm client side logs around close?

raj: python client logs below — note we get on_message(None) then generator StopAsyncIteration: 
```
# client snippet
async for chunk in stream:
    process(chunk)
# log
15:12:07.123 INFO received :hb
15:12:07.123 DEBUG on_message None
15:12:07.124 INFO generator closing -> StopAsyncIteration
```

ljp: (typo) sorry ignore

lina: on infra side i see the resume handshake increments a resume_token and we do a short buffered flush. there's a known corner where heartbeat produced while flushing can be delivered as the last frame and some clients treat that as terminal. server could add a sentinel or explicit end event but we should fix client parsing too.

emma: agreed. short-term mitigation: in python sdk change iterator to ignore comment-only events (lines starting with ":"), don't interpret them as data or end. patch proposal:
```
# pseudo patch
if event.strip().startswith(":"):
    continue  # skip heartbeat/comments
```

this avoids the generator closing on heartbeat. i'll open a PR and add tests.

arjun: for ts side, add idempotency/dedup by seqnum on the client to avoid duplicate tokens on resume. small snippet:
```
const seen = new Set();
if (!seen.has(seq)) { yield token; seen.add(seq); }
```

maria: billing concern from customer: they saw duplicated billing records after reconnects — can we confirm if duplicates are server-side or client repeated ack?

emma: looking at our billing logs, we see two delivery records for the same logical token when client resumed and re-ACKed buffered events. that suggests duplicate ingestion on our end during resume. we'll debounce server-side delivery: only mark token billed once per canonical seq id. ops will also issue a temporary credit while we patch.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1543 assigned->emma severity:high tags:[streaming, billing]

emma: next steps: 1) arjun + emma to push py-sdk hotfix to skip comment-only SSE frames and add unit test (ETA 2 days) 2) arjun to add seq dedupe in ts-sdk (ETA 3 days) 3) infra / lina to add server-side delivery idempotency for resume (ETA 5 days) 4) maria to coordinate billing credits and customer comms.

raj: thanks all — attaching small curl repro for ops:
```
# quick curl repro - server emits comment heartbeat midstream
printf "data: token1\n\n:hb\n\ndata: token2\n\n" | nc -l 3000
# client: curl -N http://localhost:3000
```

emma: perfect — thanks. if anyone on-call wants to pair on repro tonight ping me. i'll link PR + workaround in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:

arjun: will try go client too, possible EventSource lib there handles comments differently. i'll post results.

lina: adding a short change to server to hold flushing until after resume handshake confirmed to reduce buffering races. will coordinate rollback plan.

maria: i'll prepare a customer note offering credit and ETA after we confirm patch.

emma: logging follow-up: please include the resume_token and seq numbers when filing tickets — saved us a ton here.

raj: appreciate the quick turnaround team :heart:
